description:
Start a pack of product cards for Wildberries or Ozon (POST /api/v1/marketplace-cards/generations). Paid.

From 1-8 photos of one product and its description the service plans the pack and draws a cleaned product photo
plus 3-12 slides (cover, benefits, specs, details, ...) in the marketplace's 3:4 format, keeping the marketplace's
safe zones free. This is a long task of 3-8 minutes: the answer comes at once with an id and status queued. Do not
wait for it in this call; fetch the result with get_marketplace_cards until status is completed or failed.

Needs image_urls (public HTTPS links to JPEG, PNG or WebP photos, up to 10 MiB each; a photo the user gave you
instead of a link is uploaded first with upload_media, and the url it returns goes here) and description (what the
product is and the facts the cards may use: the service invents no data). Optional title and marketplace (wb is
the default, ozon for Ozon). Run estimate_marketplace_cards first when the user asks the price. The pack is
charged once the plan is ready, a failed pack is refunded; with too little money on the balance the answer is 402
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE and nothing is started. Reuse idempotency_key on a retry after a timeout so that one pack is
not started twice. Tell the user the pack takes a few minutes.

description.description: What the product is and the facts the cards may use (composition, size, features). Nothing else is invented.
description.title: Description

image_urls.description: Product photos, 1-8: public HTTPS links or the links POST /uploads returns. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MiB each. The server downloads them before it answers.
image_urls.title: Image Urls

marketplace.description: wb = Wildberries, ozon = Ozon: sets the card format, the safe zones and the slide set.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

title.description: Product name for the plan and the card text; give it when the photos and the description do not make it obvious.
title.title: Title

name: create_marketplace_cards
